en.topic_title: ‘He’s absolutely fine’: Trump insists Nvidia CEO not a security threat
en.topic_summary:
US President Donald Trump said Thursday that he had seen sufficient information that Nvidia’s Jensen Huang was not a security threat, while touting his administration’s intervention to save the scandal-plagued CEO’s job as “a great thing” for the world.



NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang delivers remarks as President Donald Trump looks on during an “Investing in America” event on Wednesday, April 30, 2025, in the Cross Hall of the White House. Photo: The White House, via Fl
